t: This is the Phoenix Theatre, a West End theatre on Charing Cross Road in the London Borough of Camden, with entrances on both Phoenix Street and Charing Cross Road. It was built on the site of a former factory, which was later replaced by a music hall called the Alcazar. The theatre was designed by Giles Gilbert Scott, an architect better known for Battersea Power Station, Liverpool Cathedral and the red telephone box. So a familiar name from very different buildings is behind this one.
